iPhone Duo, because it offers a much larger inside display, means theres all tons of new use cases that you wouldn’t normally come across with your iPhone. Of course, one of them is the fact that you might want to prop up your iPhone Duo to watch a video on the larger display.

A couple weeks ago, I wrote about one accessory that solves the kickstand problem. That said, what if you want to charge and prop up your phone at the same time?
